scope: Every feasible state of the existing ideal bridge under unchanged analysis current limits; not hardware or fault envelope
derivation: abs(Vterminal)<=Vbus and abs(Imotor)<=Ilimit imply -Ilimit+Iidle <= Idc=(Vterminal/Vbus)*Imotor+Iidle <= Ilimit+Iidle
exclusions: Servo switching/conduction losses beyond fitted model
PWM pulse peak and input-capacitor inrush
Current limit implementation, faults and latency
Tab5, external logic, conversion losses and battery current
decision: Use only as a conditional model screening envelope; do not size hardware from two turn-trace peaks or label motor-current sum as measured DC maximum
